scope: Read-only controls/water allowance audit; no CAD, master BOM, purchases or supplier messages changed.
summary: Partial source-backed itemization. Unpriced and candidate rows must not be treated as zero or released drop-in replacements.

rows.item: GCX1470-22 keyed three-position selector

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: 22 mm; four supplied blocks are 2 NO + 2 NC. Replace both NC blocks with the two CA-02 NO blocks; use two stacked NO per actuated side for R1/R2 and P1/P2.
openitems: Verify center-off and mutually exclusive closure against manufacturer cam chart; key is removable in every position.
Reuse the two removed NC blocks on CA-03; not discarded.

rows.item: ECX1040-2 normally-open contact blocks, pack of two

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: Two additional NO contacts for CA-01; manufacturer allows three blocks deep by two wide.

rows.item: GCX1300 maintained two-position selector with one NO contact

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: SETUP/RUN and AUTO/DRAIN; add one recovered NC contact from CA-01 to each for the complementary contact.
openitems: Final panel labels and a drain-override guard still needed.

rows.item: GCX1102 green momentary pushbutton with protective ring and NO contact

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: One CYCLE START; one FILL. Add CA-07 NC contact to FILL for release-to-rearm.
openitems: Verify FILL contact operating order with selected stacked block; a flush protective ring is not a hinged guard.

rows.item: GCX1104 blue momentary reset pushbutton, NO

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: Deliberate machine reset input.
openitems: Final stop-chain reset wiring remains open.

rows.item: GCX1101 red momentary pushbutton, NC

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: One FEED HOLD; one WATER STOP. Distinct functions; does not replace the latching E-stop.

rows.item: ECX1030-2 normally-closed contact blocks, pack of two

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: One additional NC for FILL; one for a second E-stop channel if the final E-stop uses this family.
openitems: Page says backordered, earliest 2026-10-02; date not guaranteed.
E-stop exact operator is not priced in this audit.

rows.item: GCX1131 latching twist-release emergency-stop operator with one NC contact

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase.
rows.fitproof: 22 mm mounting, 40 mm red mushroom, IP65, twist-to-release. Supplied ECX1030 family NC block matches the selected GCX system; manufacturer catalog specifies positive-opening contacts. CA-07 spare NC can provide the second contact if required by the finalized stop circuit.
openitems: Latest page shows backorder with forecast 2026-09-28; not guaranteed delivery.
Final stop-chain circuit and contact architecture remain unpriced under CA-14.
Legends and any required operating-button guards are CA-39.

rows.item: DN-R35S1-2 plated-steel DIN rail, two 1 m pieces

shipping.status: Advertised free US small-package shipping when the combined order exceeds $49; no ZIP-specific cart checked.

rows.fitproof: Shared rail for main controls and water relays; count this purchase once.
openitems: 2 m is a proposed cabinet purchase quantity pending panel layout, not a measured installed route.

rows.item: Adafruit 4474 USB Type-A to Type-C data cable, approximately 1 m

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Host USB-A to Kraken USB-C data connection; matches controller and Pi4B connector type.
openitems: Confirm internal routing fits 1 m; shield/strain relief and power-backfeed configuration remain to finalize.
No Ethernet cable is required for the Kraken USB motion link. An optional host-network cable is separate.

rows.item: CNC4PC C41S isolated PWM-to-0–10 V spindle board

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Primary manual documents isolated analog and relay outputs, but inputs are 5 V TTL. The present Kraken output is 3.3 V.
openitems: Needs a fail-off 3.3→5 V buffer, supply and verified 5 kHz PWM operation; not a drop-in released substitute.
Board derives run state from PWM; existing separate PG2 run request must still be independently gated through the hardware tool-permission circuit.
VFD exact control terminals/parameters and isolation/power layout are unresolved.

rows.item: Adafruit 1787 74AHCT125 3.3→5 V buffer IC

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Observed manufacturer price, OUT OF STOCK
rows.fitproof: Suitable logic-level family for 3.3 V-high detection at 5 V supply; requires an actual circuit.
openitems: Out of stock; not a purchasable completed interface.
PCB, bypassing, pull-downs, output enable defaults and mounting are not included.

rows.item: Twelve field-input isolation channels and normally-off PG2 output interface

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Twelve mapped inputs: four homes; Arc OK/UP/DOWN; E-stop/feed-hold/cycle-start; probe; permissive. Do not treat 5 V header power as 5 V-tolerant GPIO.
openitems: Select exact 24 V field-current / 3.3 V output circuits, input polarity, isolation spacing and surge protection.
K_READY wetting load must be supported; do not connect an AgNi relay contact directly to an unverified microamp GPIO.
SparkFun BOB-09118 ($5.95, two channels) was researched but not adopted as a native 24 V field-input board.

rows.item: Main disconnect, independent stop circuit, contactors, branch protection and EMI filter

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Keep all required power interruption and tool-permission functions independent of firmware.
openitems: Exact supply topology, input branch current, VFD inrush, cutter branch and restart/monitoring circuit are missing.
Do not infer a contactor's electronic-drive input suitability from its AC-3 motor rating.
Separate water SSRs and water fuse branches below are excluded from this row.

rows.item: Continuous-flex shielded motor and field-signal cable; shield clamps and protective bonding

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Existing 25–30 m motor +25–30 m signal figures are allowances. All four bipolar motor leads require functional conductors; PE must remain dedicated.
openitems: Final chain routes and motor current are not established; exact gauge, conductors, lengths and connectors remain open.
Do not adopt LUTZE A6021604-1 as four motor leads: its four conductors include green/yellow PE.
Supplied spindle kit VFD cable is not charged again.

rows.item: Shared terminal blocks, end stops/covers, glands, ferrules, wire duct, labels and panel hookup wire

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Unpriced after removal of duplicate lots
rows.fitproof: One panel-wide termination schedule must contain the water XW terminals; water branch wiring must not buy them a second time.
openitems: Quantities require completed panel layout and actual cable outside diameters.
CA-09 DIN rail and dedicated fuse/diode rows are excluded here.

rows.item: Cabinet filtered ventilation and segregated VFD housing

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: The selected enclosure is a fit envelope, not a verified thermal design.
openitems: Need VFD losses, permitted orientation, airflow paths and actual usable backplate space before fan/housing selection.
Do not replace filtered ventilation with an unprotected PC fan exposed to plasma debris.

rows.item: Host microSD, Kraken firmware microSD and CB1 heatsink/fan

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Two cards are distinct when CB1 remains installed: boot media and removable controller update media.
openitems: No zero-cost ownership assumption. Candidate Adafruit2820 was rejected because no longer stocked.
Use CB1-specific cooling; confirm any host power supply omitted from E19/E20.

rows.item: PoLabs PlasmaSensCompact standalone UP/DOWN/ARC-OK THC

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Observed manufacturer EUR price, excluding VAT and shipping
rows.fitproof: 6–36 V power, isolated Arc OK/UP/DOWN outputs; matches firmware function concept.
openitems: EUR price is not a USD checkout price; no invented exchange conversion.
Unknown cutter model, voltage interface, HF-start behavior and torch trigger prevent unconditional compatibility approval.
Use documented cutter CNC connections; do not treat pilot-arc torch identity as proof of power-source compatibility.

rows.item: Littelfuse 0FHA0001ZXJ inline ATO fuse holder

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Three branch holders: pump, control, valve/timers. Primary rating20 A/32 VDC.
openitems: Holder leads are a local gauge transition; verify conductor protection/termination in final drawing.
Tariff may apply in cart.

rows.item: Littelfuse 0287010.U 10 A ATO fuse

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Pump conductor protection, per current water electrical design.
openitems: Actual pump instruction and startup pulse must support10 A; do not increase blindly.

rows.item: Littelfuse 0287001.U 1 A ATO fuse

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Control and valve/timer branches; U is bulk packaging sold individually and replaces the previous L packing code electrically.

rows.item: Vishay 1N4007-E3/54 diode, cut tape

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Six relay suppression diodes; two drain-command OR diodes; two ready-OR diodes. Not eight.
openitems: Insulated supported installation and polarity inspection required; possible cart tariff.

rows.item: STMicroelectronics STPS20100CT pump flyback diode

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: Manufacturer datasheet: dual10 A,100 V common cathode, TO-220; pin1/3 anodes, pin2/tab cathode. Functional replacement candidate for obsolete onsemi MBR20100CTG.
openitems: Validate pump stop-pulse thermal duty, insulated tab mounting and final protection; component substitution only, not a tested motor-protection system.
Primary data: https://www.digikey.com/htmldatasheets/production/1010540/0/0/1/stps20100ct.pdf

rows.item: Finder39.81.0.024.0060 DIN on-delay timers, alternative to AH3-3

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

rows.fitproof: 24 V, one timed SPDT, on-delay mode, ranges include10 s and75 s;6.2 mm width. Primary data https://cdn.findernet.com/app/uploads/S39EN.pdf
openitems: Not pin-compatible with AH3-3; revise terminal schedule if chosen.
Published minimum load500 mW (12 V/10 mA) may be missed when T_CLOSE feeds only an SSR input. A calculated wetting load or lower-minimum-load timer is required.
This pair costs$77.18 versus old$20.78; do not book as savings or a fully released substitution.

rows.item: Parker 801-8-BLU-RL 1/2-inch Push-Lok hose, cut length

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase. Quantity is feet: 10 ft = 3.048 m.
rows.fitproof: Parker publishes 300 PSI, 28 inHg vacuum, 125 mm minimum bend radius, water temperature limit 85 C, and matching 82-series fittings. Use as one matched set with CA-33/34/35/40.
openitems: Parker excludes extreme pulsation. Confirm the selected diaphragm pump's pulsation is acceptable or obtain a qualified crimped alternative before adoption.
Confirm water-treatment chemical compatibility, actual route length and 125 mm bends.
Do not add worm clamps or generic hose barbs to the 82-series Push-Lok connections.

rows.item: Kuriyama K3150-16X100 Clearbraid 1-inch gravity drain hose, cut length

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase. Quantity is feet: 5 ft = 1.524 m; page says in stock.
rows.fitproof: 1-inch ID reinforced PVC water hose, 125 PSI at 70 F / 75 PSI at 122 F. Selected only for gravity drain, never for the 120 PSI pump circuit.
openitems: Keep a continuously descending, supported route without kinks; protect from hot slag.
Verify water-treatment compatibility and required installed length.

rows.item: Breeze 63016 all-stainless hose clamps, 10-piece minimum purchase

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public indexed offer 2026-09-24; minimum/multiple 10, $1.34 each. Direct fetch returned 403; recheck cart.
rows.fitproof: 13/16 to 1-1/2-inch range covers the nominal 1.3-inch OD gravity hose. All-stainless band and screw. Allow two for gravity drain retention, eight spare.
openitems: This reduced clamp count applies only if the matched Parker push-on pump set is adopted; otherwise original small-hose clamps still require selection.
Do not fit these over Parker 82-series connections.
Confirm barb engagement and installed hose OD before tightening.

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.item: Parker 30182-8-8 1/2-inch MNPTF x 1/2-inch Push-Lok fitting, pickup adapter portion

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase.

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase.

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

rows.basis: Public offer observed 2026-09-24; goods only, no cart or purchase.

shipping.status: Shipping to Alto GA 30510 is unquoted; do not assume free.

shipping.status: Unquoted to Alto GA 30510; do not assume free.

simplifications.proposal: Use an existing suitable PC as the USB G-code sender.
simplifications.cash_reduction_condition: Only after user confirms suitable owned PC. CB1+carrier alone would remove current$61.97; host cooling/storage share ofE21 can then be recalculated. Kraken firmware update media and USB cable still needed.

simplifications.proposal: One cabinet-wide termination/cable/label schedule, including water wiring.
simplifications.cash_reduction_condition: Remove duplicate quantities, not whole protective functions. Current lots cannot be summed as exact purchases.

simplifications.proposal: Retain automatic drain/refill with independent high-high/low-water interruption.
simplifications.cash_reduction_condition: No compressor pressure/vacuum is applied to the vented tank. No cheap generic relay substitution credited against documented SSRs.

source_notes: Amazon-first targeted searches did not establish a complete, traceable exact offer for the added control interfaces and modular switches. Manufacturer/distributor sources were used for those items.
Current core Amazon offers are being rechecked separately by the parent; existing observed water prices are not reasserted as newly verified by this audit.
Prices are goods prices before tax, unknown shipping and any cart tariff. Positive-priced candidate rows are NOT all additive to a selected BOM.

Follow-up: exact GCX1131 and gravity plumbing prices added; selected subtotal is partial goods, not a whole controls/water quote. Parker pump hose/fittings and reduced clamp count remain a separate conditional option.
